verdict.rationale: Column documents API origination of ACH credits and debits through its own direct Federal Reserve integration. Its guides cover ACH origination and simulated incoming ACH credits and debits, and it offers configurable webhook endpoints for events. Nothing in the pack covers same-day ACH windows or modeling returns, NOCs, or reversals as first-class objects. Missing for 10: same-day ACH window support, returns/NOC/reversal objects, ACH-specific webhook event types, independent hands-on corroboration.
